Title: OTP grant — the same code cannot sign in twice
Preconditions:
OtpSignIn.Enabled is on for {{STORE_ID}}; {{USER_EMAIL}} is a contact of {{STORE_ID}} with lockout enabled and a non-expired password
admin credentials resolve
Steps: [AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token [CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time, taken immediately before the code is requested [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/otp/request, no Authorization header, JSON body {"storeId":"{{STORE_ID}}","email":"{{USER_EMAIL}}"} [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and JSON body {"keyword":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","take":5,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [WAIT] poll that call up to 90s until an OtpSignInEmailNotification message to {{USER_EMAIL}} created after T0 appears (SMTP may be off - the message is journaled either way) [CAPTURE] code = the 6-digit value inside ... in that message body [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=otp_email, scope=offline_access, storeId={{STORE_ID}}, email={{USER_EMAIL}}, code=code [CAPTURE] firstToken = access_token of the first grant [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=otp_email, scope=offline_access, storeId={{STORE_ID}}, email={{USER_EMAIL}}, code=code - the SAME code again, immediately [HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/currentuser with firstToken (the first session itself stays valid)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] no unexpected 5xx on the endpoint under test
[API] response body is valid JSON with the documented error shape
Failure_Signals: KNOWN GAP (VCST-5748, round 2): the build issues a second token for the used code (code stays valid ~6-9 min; Identity Email provider does not consume it) - expected to FAIL until the product invalidates on use or the wording is changed; do NOT flip the expectation. 4xx/5xx other than the asserted one, empty or malformed response body, an access_token where a refusal is expected
Cleanup: Reset the failed-attempt counter of {{USER_EMAIL}}: request a fresh code and grant with it once (a successful grant zeroes the counter; once the product consumes a code on use the repeat grant above records a failed attempt on this SHARED persona)
